atoms.text: Benicio, Adele and Courtney love to cook and eat together, but they have a hard time coming up with a recipe that only contains ingredients they all like. Listen to their phone call while they are debating what to cook for dinner.

text.text: You can scroll up to look at the Venn diagram again.

instruction.text: Fill in the gaps by using the information you get from the Venn diagram.

atoms.b: <t-blue>Benicio</t-blue>, <t-lightYellow>Courtney</t-lightYellow>, can you both hear me? What should we cook for dinner tonight? I would love to eat some ((++mushrooms onions)).
atoms.sound: ssml: Benicio? Courtney? Can you both hear me? What should we cook for dinner tonight? I would love to eat some mushrooms. <break time='1500ms'/>

atoms.b: <t-purple>Adele</t-purple>, you should know that I don’t like mushrooms. I remember that <t-blue>Benicio</t-blue> likes ((++fish dill)), just like me. Right <t-blue>Benicio</t-blue>?
atoms.sound: ssml: Adele, you should know that I don’t like mushrooms. I remember that Benicio likes fish, just like me. Right Benicio?<break time='1500ms'/>

atoms.b: Yes, I do like fish. One thing is for sure, we all like ((kiwi ++salt)) with our food. My perfect meal would be a yummy fish with salt, onions and ((mango ++dill)).  However, <t-purple>Adele</t-purple> doesn’t like fish, right?
atoms.sound: ssml: Yes, I do like fish. One thing is for sure, we all like salt with our food. My perfect meal would be a yummy fish with salt, onions and dill. However, Adele doesn’t like fish, right? <break time='1500ms'/>

atoms.b: Yes <t-blue>Benicio</t-blue>, you are right, I really don’t like fish. How about you and <t-lightYellow>Courtney</t-lightYellow> eat ((++fish onions)), and I’ll just have mushrooms with a salad on the side.
atoms.sound: ssml: Yes Benicio, you are right, I really don’t like fish. How about you and Courtney eat fish, and I’ll just have mushrooms with a salad on the side.<break time='1500ms'/>

atoms.b: Good idea <t-purple>Adele</t-purple>. We could make a fruit salad. We both like ((++kiwi mango)), and I’ll just add some ((++mango kiwi)) in mine.
atoms.sound: ssml: Good idea. Adele, we could make a fruit salad. We both like kiwi, and I’ll just add some mango in mine.<break time='1500ms'/>

atoms.b: All right, that sounds like a good plan! Now we just need to decide where we’re going to cook!
atoms.sound: ssml: All right, that sounds like a good plan! Now we just need to decide where we’re going to cook!
